threshold_info.risk_high: Model risk at or above this value is shown as high.
threshold_info.risk_moderate: Model risk at or above this value is shown as moderate.
threshold_info.ddcfdna_pct: 1% is the cut-off most often used to separate normal from abnormal dd-cfDNA (e.g. DART). Some centres use 0.5-0.75%. Not evaluated in the first month, when dd-cfDNA is physiologically raised.
threshold_info.dsa_mfi: MFI >= 1,400 is the binary DSA cut-off used by the iBox prognostication system. Laboratory cut-offs differ.
threshold_info.dsa_rise_pct: Relative rise in the immunodominant DSA MFI versus the previous measurement.
threshold_info.tac_cv_pct: Published cut-offs for high tacrolimus intrapatient variability span roughly 23-40%. Computed over the stable phase only (month 3 onward, >= 3 troughs).
threshold_info.egfr_drop_pct: Relative eGFR decline vs ~3 months earlier (CKD-EPI 2021). Not evaluated before month 3, while early graft function is still settling.
threshold_info.eplet_class2: Class II (DR+DQ) eplet mismatch >= 14 was associated with more de novo class II DSA (Sakamoto 2020).

model.model: Calibrated gradient boosting (scikit-learn HistGradientBoosting + isotonic calibration)
model.explainer: Counterfactual reset per factor on the production model (percentage points of risk)
model.target: Biopsy-proven TCMR or ABMR within 12 months of the visit
model.inputs: Recipient/donor baseline, HLA (A/B/DR mismatch, class II eplets, PIRCHE-II), cPRA, eGFR (CKD-EPI 2021) and its 3-month change, UPCR, tacrolimus trough/CV/TTR, dd-cfDNA, DSA (MFI, class), BK, prior rejection
model.data: Fully synthetic cohort generated by ml/cortex_ml/sim.py. No real patient data.
limitations: Performance on synthetic data does not predict performance on real patients: the model has learned the simulator.
Requires retrospective validation on local cohorts and prospective silent-mode evaluation before any clinical use.
Eplet and PIRCHE-II values are simulated; production use requires HLAMatchmaker / PIRCHE-II from high-resolution typing.
Not modelled yet: CMV, primary kidney disease and recurrence risk, MMF/steroid exposure, blood pressure, PTDM.
Not a medical device. Decision support only; the treating clinician decides.

considerations: Isolated dd-cfDNA elevation: consider repeat dd-cfDNA and DSA testing; exclude infection, including BK.
Proteinuria: repeat UPCR; consider recurrent disease or chronic injury in the differential.

biopsies.result: No rejection; IFTA grade I (ci1, ct1)

considerations: Pattern compatible with active allograft injury: consider for-cause biopsy per centre protocol, after excluding obstruction and vascular causes on Doppler ultrasound.
DSA positive: consider repeat single-antigen bead testing (with C1q if available) and review immunosuppression intensity and adherence.
BK viremia: follow BK PCR; reduction of immunosuppression is usually considered, weighed against rejection risk (DSA, dd-cfDNA).
